Name: MAP_GRID_CREATE_HEIGHT_LIMIT_INFO_PARAM_ST
Description: Height limits for loading overworld grid tiles. The row ID is the _02 tile (the largest tile size) as a number (m60_08_12_02 → 60081202), and covers every smaller tile inside it. A tile near the player is only loaded while the player's height is within the row's range, with 10 m of tolerance on each side; a tile with no row has no limit. Retail: tiles around m60_08–10_12–13, split at 600 m.

Fields.Name: Min Height - Grid Creation (LOD2)
Fields.Description: Lowest player height at which the tiles are loaded, in m (the game allows 10 m below it).

Fields.Name: Max Height - Grid Creation (LOD2)
Fields.Description: Highest player height at which the tiles are loaded, in m (the game allows 10 m above it).
